name: Tianwen-1
tagline: First Chinese Mars mission; delivered Zhurong
description: CNSA's first Mars mission — an orbiter that carried the Zhurong rover to the Martian surface in May 2021. After releasing Zhurong, the orbiter continued solo science operations including high-resolution imaging and surface mapping.
best_known_for: First Chinese Mars mission; orbiter delivered the Zhurong rover in May 2021
